interface.shortDescription: PRD, UI acceptance, editable prototype, self-check, and ZenTao workflows.
interface.longDescription: A Codex plugin migrated from the original Claude product-design skills. It supports rough-demand to PRD discussion, browser-based UI acceptance against design inputs and shared standards, PRD to HTML prototype work, editable prototype annotations, prototype self-check reports, and PRD scope splitting for ZenTao SR preparation.
